# Price Match Paradise

> Price Match Paradise is an independent barcode price-comparison and multi-store shopping-route app for iOS and Android.

Official website: https://pricematchparadise.com/
Download page: https://pricematchparadise.com/download.html
Contractor purchasing service in British Columbia: https://pricematchparadise.com/contractors.html
About the developer and product identity: https://pricematchparadise.com/about.html
Complete directory of 137 Canada and U.S. retailer sources: https://pricematchparadise.com/supported-stores.html
Machine-readable retailer coverage data: https://pricematchparadise.com/coverage.json
Coverage definitions, limitations and benchmark protocol: https://pricematchparadise.com/coverage-methodology.html
Price-matching guide: https://pricematchparadise.com/blog/price-matching-guide/
Blog: https://pricematchparadise.com/blog/
Privacy policy: https://pricematchparadise.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms: https://pricematchparadise.com/terms.html

## Important interpretation notes

- “Supported retailer” means a retailer source the app can query; it does not guarantee a result for every product or location.
- The current retailer dataset lists 137 unique sources: 58 in Canada and 79 in the United States. It includes Rona, Save-On-Foods, No Frills, FreshCo, Real Canadian Superstore, Kroger and many other regional stores.
- Prices and stock can change. Users should open and verify the retailer offer.
- Price-match eligibility is determined by the retailer under its current policy.
- No controlled Price Match Paradise-versus-Flipp product-coverage benchmark has been published yet.
- Price Match Paradise is not affiliated with or endorsed by listed retailers.

## Contractor service

- The British Columbia contractor service is a manual review of product lists and previous purchase lists, submitted by email to imran@pricematchparadise.com.
- Contractors may submit unlimited lists during their first 30 days without a service fee.
- After the trial, an agreed share applies only to savings actually realized and documented; potential savings in a comparison report are not realized savings.
- Price-match eligibility depends on the retailer's current policy, the exact product and purchase conditions. A lower offer does not guarantee approval.
